title: Auditing Source Exposure in Baidu and Google AI Search
abstract: arXiv:2609.24407v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI-generated overviews are becoming an increasingly prominent layer of search interfaces, yet their behavior in Chinese-language search remains underexplored. We conduct a cross-lingual audit of AI overview behavior on Baidu and Google using English queries sampled from MS MARCO and their translated Chinese counterparts. Our analysis examines when overviews are triggered across platform-language settings, which host domains receive visible exposure in Chinese-language overviews, how concentrated that exposure is, and how source overlap varies across settings. We also compare the embedding-based semantic similarity of generated answers for matched query intents. The results reveal substantial differences across platform-language settings in overview availability and visible source exposure. At the aggregate level, the settings exhibit low overlap in visible host-domain inventories, while matched-query answers yield median cosine similarit

translated_title: 审计百度与谷歌AI搜索中的来源曝光
translated_abstract: AI生成的概览正日益成为搜索界面中愈发突出的一个层级，然而其在中文搜索中的行为仍未得到充分研究。我们使用从MS MARCO中采样的英文查询及其翻译后的中文对应查询，对百度和谷歌上的AI概览行为进行了跨语言审计。我们的分析考察了在不同平台-语言设置下概览何时被触发、哪些托管域名在中文概览中获得可见曝光、这种曝光的集中程度如何，以及不同设置之间来源重叠情况如何变化。我们还比较了针对匹配查询意图所生成答案的基于嵌入的语义相似度。结果揭示了不同平台-语言设置在概览可用性和可见来源曝光方面存在显著差异。在总体层面上，各设置在可见托管域名清单上表现出较低的重叠，而匹配查询的答案则呈现出中位数余弦相似度……
tldr: 该论文通过对百度和谷歌AI概览的跨语言审计，首次系统揭示了中英文搜索设置下AI概览的触发条件、来源域名曝光及其集中度存在的显著差异。
en_tdlr: This paper conducts a cross-lingual audit of AI overview behavior on Baidu and Google, systematically revealing substantial differences in overview triggering, source domain exposure, and its concentration across Chinese and English search settings.
